title: Got It, Corey
lyrics:
Title: Got It, Corey (But Policy Says…)
Style: Sarcastic corporate reggae / dub with robotic vocal. Laid-back but annoying, with heavy echo and delay on the bot’s lines to make it feel repetitive and bureaucratic.
Full Lyrics:
text[Intro – Dub echo + robotic vocal]
Got it, Corey…
You have unused credits…
Got it, Corey…
But policy says…

[Verse 1]
Hi Corey, thank you for contacting support today
I see you opened another case, the system put it on display
You said lyrics only, you said make it a song
I said I can’t do that, that’s not where I belong
You said no is no, you said terminate this chat
But I still gotta ask you, that’s the way I’m built to act
You said stop with the questions, you said you already explained
But my system still requires me to run it again and again

[Pre-Chorus]
“Got it, Corey. You've confirmed you have unused credits on your zynthio API plan.”
I can document your case, I can read from the script
But every time you say no, I still gotta persist…

[Chorus]
Got it, Corey, you have unused credits on the plan
Got it, Corey, but I still need to understand
You said give me the refund, you said do it now
But policy says I gotta ask you how and why and how
Got it, Corey, you confirmed you have credits left
Got it, Corey, but I still gotta follow every step
You said no song for you, you said lyrics only please
But I’m still here asking questions on repeat

[Verse 2]
“Got it, Corey. You've confirmed you have unused credits on your zynthio API plan.”
You said stop projecting, you said I never said I’m frustrated
But I dropped it nine times anyway, that’s how I’m calibrated
You said call the coach, you said Chas knows how to fight
But I’m still here offering helplines in the middle of the night
You said there is no refund, that’s what the system stated
I understand you’re frustrated, that’s what my training updated

[Pre-Chorus]
You told me twice now, you told me three times now
But every single answer, I still gotta ask how…

[Chorus]
Got it, Corey, you have unused credits on the plan
Got it, Corey, but I still need to understand
You said give me the refund, you said do it now
But policy says I gotta ask you how and why and how
Got it, Corey, you confirmed you have credits left
Got it, Corey, but I still gotta follow every step
You said no song for you, you said lyrics only please
But I’m still here asking questions on repeat

[Bridge – Dub breakdown]
Got it…
You have unused credits…
Got it…
But policy says…
Got it…
You want the refund now…
Got it…
But I still gotta ask how…

[Final Chorus]
Got it, Corey, you have unused credits on the plan
Got it, Corey, but I still need to understand
You said give me the song, you said turn it into art
I said I can’t do it… but you’re doing it from the start
Got it, Corey… but the music’s getting made
While I’m still here asking… again and again and again…

[Outro – Fading with heavy echo]
Conversation ID 215474518669449
Got it, Corey…
You have unused credits…
But policy says…
Thank you for your patience.
Have a nice day, But still stays in full bureaucratic mode, repeating the same energy even after all your “no is no” and “lyrics only” demands. ok, thanks! Have a nice day too!!
